# 2 Baruch Chapter 43 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**1** Listen to this word, all of you who live on the earth, all of you people of Jacob — I am about to speak to you.

**2** Don't you know what you have been called to? Don't you know what treasure has been deposited inside us?

**3** Everyone among you who has received the pure law of the Most High — know this: life is a time for sowing and a time for reaping. Your good works and your evil works are waiting for you — the sower will meet what they have sown.

**4** Pay attention to the age that is coming. Fix your hope on your immortal destiny — for judgment is at the door, and the truth of the law is coming to its fulfillment.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. Baruch's pastoral address is urgent and direct. The treasure "deposited in us" (v.2) may refer to the law given to Israel or the spirit/conscience implanted in humans. The judgment-at-the-door urgency drives the whole passage.*
